resourceName: Shunping MSW Incineration and Power Generation PPP Project
description: Shunping MSW Incineration and Power Generation PPP Project (hereafter referred to as “the project”) is located at the west side of Muze copper material factory in Shunping County and the north side of Baofu Expressway, Baoding City, Hebei Province, P.R.China. The Project is invested, constructed and operated by Shunping County SUS Renewable Energy Co., Ltd. (hereafter referred to as “the project owner”).This project is the first ultra-low emission domestic waste power plant in Hebei Province.   The purpose of the project is to treat fresh MSW with two 500t/d MSW combustion lines and utilize recovered waste heat for electricity generation. The MSW treatment system is composed of two 500t/d mechanical grate incinerators, matched with two sets of 12MW steam turbine and two sets of 12MW generator. The project will process 365,000 tons [ 365000t/d is the design value of the daily MSW intake in FSR. ] of MSW every year, and consume 500 tons of 0# light diesel as auxiliary fuel. The MSW combustion lines will generate 135,700 MWh electricity every year, of which 108,600 MWh will be exported to the North China Power Grid (NCPG). The implementation of the project will meet the requirement of local MSW harmless treatment, and significantly improve local environment. Also, the project fits the priority development sector of integrated utilization of resource and energy saving of China, and helps reduce GHG emission that would occur in baseline scenarios such as power generating by fossil-fuel fired plants and MSW treatment at landfill.    The project started construction on 31 December 2020 and put into trial operation on 13 May 2022. It is estimated that during the 10-year fixed crediting period of the project (from 13 May 2022 to 12 May 2032), the average annual GHG emission reductions will be 59,854 tCO2e. The total amount of emission reductions is expected to be 598,549 tCO2e during the 10-year fixed crediting period.
